SELECT s.id, s.revision, s.latest_at, r.read_at FROM (
SELECT id, CONCAT(id, '|', created_at) revision, created_at latest_at FROM community_report WHERE state = 'OPEN'
SELECT id, CONCAT(id, '|', COALESCE(gmt_modified, gmt_create)) revision, COALESCE(gmt_modified, gmt_create) latest_at FROM feedback WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (official_reply IS NULL OR TRIM(official_reply) = '')
SELECT id, CONCAT(id, '|', COALESCE(gmt_modified, gmt_create)) revision, COALESCE(gmt_modified, gmt_create) latest_at FROM food_nutrition WHERE nutrition_source = 'AI_ESTIMATE' AND shelf_status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT g.id, CONCAT(g.id, '|', g.glucose_value, '|', g.recorded_at, '|', h.id) revision, g.gmt_modified latest_at FROM glucose_record g JOIN user_account u ON u.id = g.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1 JOIN gp_glucose_alert_case h ON h.id = ( SELECT h2.id FROM gp_glucose_alert_case h2 WHERE h2.record_id = g.id ORDER BY h2.handled_at DESC, h2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE g.is_deleted = 0 AND (h.glucose_value <> g.glucose_value OR h.recorded_at <> g.recorded_at)
SELECT d.user_id id, CONCAT(d.user_id, '|', d.version) revision, d.updated_at latest_at FROM consultation_doctor d JOIN user_account u ON u.id=d.user_id WHERE d.status='PENDING' AND u.is_deleted=0 AND u.account_status=1
SELECT e.id, CONCAT(o.order_no, '|', o.version) revision, o.created_at latest_at FROM wallet_withdrawal_order o JOIN wallet_withdrawal_event e ON e.order_no=o.order_no AND e.event_type='FREEZE' WHERE o.status='PENDING'
SELECT a.news_id id, CONCAT(a.news_id, '|', a.revision, '|', a.updated_at) revision, a.updated_at latest_at FROM community_article a JOIN cms_news n ON n.id=a.news_id WHERE a.state='PENDING_ADMIN' AND n.community_managed=1 AND n.is_deleted=0
SELECT g.id, CONCAT(g.id, '|', g.glucose_value, '|', g.recorded_at) revision, g.gmt_modified latest_at FROM glucose_record g JOIN user_account u ON u.id=g.user_id AND u.is_deleted=0 LEFT JOIN gp_glucose_alert_case h ON h.record_id=g.id AND h.glucose_value=g.glucose_value AND h.recorded_at=g.recorded_at WHERE g.is_deleted=0 AND g.glucose_value>0 AND g.glucose_value<40 AND (g.glucose_value<3.9 OR g.glucose_value>=10) AND g.node_code IN ('before_breakfast','after_breakfast','before_lunch', 'after_lunch','before_dinner','after_dinner') AND COALESCE(h.status,'PENDING')='PENDING'
SELECT id, '' revision, created_at latest_at FROM community_report WHERE 1 = 0
) s LEFT JOIN admin_work_reminder_read r ON r.ops_id = #{opsId} AND r.kind = #{kind} AND r.source_id = s.id
AND CAST(r.revision AS BINARY(255)) = CAST(s.revision AS BINARY(255)) ORDER BY s.id
